name: Worst interval starts for distinct-multiple matching
description: construct() -> Python integer m in 0..1000000. The evaluator computes f(12,m), the LEAST positive L such that (m,m+L] contains distinct b_1,...,b_12 with i dividing b_i. Maximize this independently computed L. Exact bipartite matching plus monotone binary search evaluates every proposal. The task fixes n=12 and bounds m by one million; it optimizes the exact finite f(n,m). It neither searches arbitrary integer sets as in JSP-000578 nor establishes asymptotic worst-case growth.

sources.locator: Wouter van Doorn, On the length of an interval that contains distinct multiples of the first n positive integers (2026). Section 1 defines f(n,m) with the half-open interval (m,m+f(n,m)] and studies max_m f(n,m)-f(n,n).
JSP-000580; pinned revision bcf1866ea9a4ae82b32bd95b82ffd812b9ee80d2. Independently paraphrased finite adaptation; catalog contributor claims are not accepted as proof.
